joshua: Moses is dead. Be strong and courageous. Rahab hides the spies. A scarlet cord.
The spies return. The Jordan is in flood. Consecrate yourselves.
The ark goes first. The waters stand. Israel crosses on dry ground.
Twelve stones from the riverbed. Circumcision at Gilgal. The manna stops. The commander of the Lord’s army.
Jericho: six days of silence, a seventh of shouting. The walls fall. Rahab is spared. Achan’s ban.
Ai: first defeat because of the devoted things. Achan is found. Then an ambush, and Ai falls.
The Gibeonites trick Israel into a treaty with mouldy bread. The treaty stands.
Five kings attack Gibeon. The sun is said to stand still. The kings in a cave.
The southern campaign. Hazor in the north later. A long war, then rest.
The northern coalition. Hazor burned. The Anakim cut off. The land has rest from war.
Kings defeated, east and west of the Jordan, listed.
Land still to be taken. Inheritance begins. Caleb claims Hebron at eighty-five.
Judah’s lot. Jerusalem not fully taken. Caleb and Othniel. The Kenites.
Ephraim and Manasseh. The forest to be cleared. You are a numerous people.
The remaining seven tribes. The tent at Shiloh. Lots cast.
Benjamin’s lot. Jerusalem on the border.
Simeon within Judah. Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, Dan. Joshua’s own town.
Cities of refuge: Kedesh, Shechem, Hebron, Bezer, Ramoth, Golan.
Levitical cities and pasturelands, given by lot.
The eastern tribes go home. An altar by the Jordan nearly starts a war, then is named Witness.
Joshua old: cling to the Lord, or these nations will be snares. I am going the way of all the earth.
A recap of the story from Abraham. Choose this day whom you will serve. We will serve the Lord.
A covenant at Shechem. A stone as witness. The people say they will not forsake the Lord.
Joshua dies. Joseph’s bones buried at Shechem. Eleazar dies. The book ends with a generation that knew the works of the Lord.
judges: After Joshua, incomplete conquest. Judah goes up. Iron chariots. The Angel at Bochim.
A new generation that did not know the Lord. The cycle: forget, oppress, cry, a judge, rest, repeat.
Othniel. Ehud and the fat king of Moab. Shamgar and an ox-goad.
Deborah, Barak, Sisera. Jael and a tent peg. The stars fought from heaven.
The song of Deborah. The peasantry ceased in Israel until I arose.
Gideon is called from the winepress. An altar of Baal pulled down at night.
The fleece. Three hundred with torches and jars. The Midianites turn on themselves.
Ephraim’s complaint. Succoth and Penuel. Gideon refuses a crown, then makes an ephod that becomes a snare. Abimelech.
Abimelech murders seventy brothers. Jotham’s parable of the trees. A millstone from a tower.
Tola, Jair. Israel’s confession. Jephthah the son of a prostitute is fetched from Tob.
Jephthah’s vow. A daughter comes out to meet him. A war with Ephraim and a shibboleth.
Ibzan, Elon, Abdon. Then Israel again does evil, and the Philistines.
Samson’s birth announced. A Nazirite from the womb. The Spirit begins to stir.
Samson’s riddle, a Philistine wife, thirty men paid in garments from Ashkelon.
Foxes and torches. A jawbone of a donkey. Water from a hollow place.
Delilah. The hair. Gaza’s gates. The temple of Dagon, and a death that kills more than his life.
Micah’s shrine, a hired Levite, a silver idol in the hill country of Ephraim.
Danites take the Levite and the idol, burn Laish, set up a rival sanctuary.
A Levite’s concubine, Gibeah’s crime, a body in twelve pieces sent through Israel.
War against Benjamin. Almost a tribe is wiped out. Four hundred thousand, then a remnant.
Wives for Benjamin from Jabesh-gilead and from the dancers at Shiloh. In those days there was no king.
ruth: Famine. Elimelech’s family in Moab. The men die. Naomi comes home empty; Ruth will not leave her.
Ruth gleans in Boaz’s field. He has heard of her loyalty. Dip your bread in the wine.
The threshing floor at night. A cloak, a request for redemption. Boaz will settle it at the gate.
The nearer kinsman declines. Boaz marries Ruth. Obed is born. A genealogy to David.
1samuel: Hannah prays for a son and is thought drunk. Samuel is lent to the Lord. Her song.
Eli’s sons are worthless. A man of God against Eli’s house. Samuel ministers.
The Lord calls Samuel in the night. Speak, for your servant hears. The word is rare in those days.
The ark is taken. Ichabod. Eli dies. The glory has departed.
The ark among the Philistines. Dagon falls. Tumours. Send it back with guilt offerings.
The ark at Beth-shemesh, then Kiriath-jearim. Twenty years. Return to the Lord.
Samuel judges. Ebenezer: thus far the Lord has helped us. His sons take bribes. Israel asks for a king.
This will be the way of the king. They refuse to listen. Give us a king like the nations.
Saul looking for donkeys is anointed. Another heart. Is Saul also among the prophets?
Saul is chosen by lot. Some despise him. He holds his peace.
Nahash of Ammon. Saul’s first victory. The kingdom renewed at Gilgal.
Samuel’s farewell. The Lord sent Moses and Aaron. Do not turn aside from following the Lord.
Saul’s unlawful sacrifice. Your kingdom will not continue. The Lord has sought a man after his own heart.
Jonathan’s exploit. Honey, a rash oath, the people ransom Jonathan.
Amalek not devoted as commanded. To obey is better than sacrifice. The Lord regrets Saul.
David is anointed. The Spirit rushes. Saul is tormented. David plays the lyre.
Goliath. David and a sling. The battle is the Lord’s.
Jonathan loves David. Saul’s jealousy. A spear in the wall. Michal’s deception.
David flees to Samuel. Saul among the prophets again.
Jonathan’s arrows. David and Jonathan weep. The Lord is between you and me forever.
Ahimelech, the holy bread, Goliath’s sword. Doeg. David at Gath, mad in their eyes.
The cave of Adullam. Everyone in distress gathers. Saul slaughters the priests of Nob.
Keilah, the wilderness of Ziph. Jonathan finds David and strengthens his hand in God.
David spares Saul in the cave. The skirt of the robe. The Lord judge between us.
Nabal and Abigail. A fool’s name. David takes her as wife. Saul gives Michal to another.
David spares Saul a second time, the spear and the jar. Why does my lord pursue a dead dog?
David among the Philistines at Ziklag. Achish thinks he is theirs forever.
Saul and the medium at Endor. Samuel’s ghost: tomorrow you and your sons shall be with me.
David is sent home from the Philistine muster. The commanders do not trust him.
Ziklag burned, the wives taken. David strengthens himself in the Lord. Amalek overtaken.
Saul and Jonathan die on Gilboa. The armour-bearer. The bodies on the wall of Beth-shan.
2samuel: David’s lament: how the mighty have fallen. The song of the bow.
David king at Hebron. Abner makes Ish-bosheth king. A grim contest at Gibeon.
Abner defects, is murdered by Joab. David laments a prince and a great man fallen.
Ish-bosheth is murdered in his bed. David has the killers executed.
David king of all Israel. Jerusalem taken. Hiram’s cedar. More children. Philistines struck.
The ark brought up. Uzzah. David dances. Michal despises him.
A house of cedar, a house forever. David’s prayer: who am I, O Lord God?
Victories listed. Moab, Zobah, Edom. The Lord gave victory wherever he went.
Mephibosheth at the king’s table, for Jonathan’s sake.
Ammon and Hanun. Beards and tunics. Joab: be of good courage. The Lord do what seems good.
Spring, rooftops, Bathsheba, Uriah’s letter. You are the man — not yet spoken.
Nathan’s ewe lamb. The child dies. Solomon is born. Rabbah taken.
Amnon and Tamar. Absalom’s silence. Two years, then a feast and a killing.
The wise woman of Tekoa. Joab. Absalom returns, but does not see the king’s face.
Absalom steals hearts at the gate. The conspiracy at Hebron. David flees.
Ziba, Shimei cursing, Hushai versus Ahithophel. Counsel as if one had inquired of God.
Ahithophel’s counsel defeated. A hanging. A letter, a well, a covering of grain.
The forest of Ephraim. Absalom in the oak. Joab’s darts. O my son Absalom.
The king’s grief almost costs the victory. Joab is blunt. Judah and Israel quarrel over the king.
Sheba’s revolt. A wise woman at Abel. Joab, the head over the wall. The revolt ends.
The Gibeonites and Saul’s blood. Rizpah’s vigil. War with the Philistines. Giants.
David’s song of deliverance: the Lord is my rock. He drew me out of many waters.
Last words of David. The Thirty and the Three. Uriah the Hittite in the list.
A census. Wrath. A threshing floor, an altar. The plague stops. The site of the future temple.
1kings: David old. Adonijah exalts himself. Nathan and Bathsheba. Solomon is made king.
David’s charge. Joab and Shimei. Solomon’s throne established. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
A political marriage. Gibeon. Wisdom to govern. Two women and a child.
Officials, daily provision, peace on every side. Wisdom like the sand, proverbs and songs.
Hiram of Tyre. Cedar and cypress. Forced labour. The temple’s dimensions.
The interior: gold, cherubim, carved gourds. Seven years building.
Solomon’s house thirteen years. The bronze sea, stands, shovels. Hiram the craftsman.
The ark brought in. Glory fills the house. Solomon’s prayer: hear in heaven your dwelling place.
Fire and glory. The feast. The Lord appears a second time: if you walk, if you turn.
The queen of Sheba. Gold, ships, a throne of ivory. Solomon exceeded all the earth in riches and wisdom.
Foreign wives, high places. Ahijah and the tearing of the cloak. Adversaries raised.
Rehoboam’s young men. A heavier yoke. The kingdom splits. Jeroboam’s calves at Bethel and Dan.
A man of God from Judah. An altar split. A lion on the road. Jeroboam’s house condemned.
Ahijah and Jeroboam’s sick son. Nadab. Baasha. The word against the house of Jeroboam fulfilled.
Asa of Judah. Nadab, Baasha, Elah, Zimri, Omri, Ahab. Samaria built. Ahab’s Baal.
Elijah: no rain. A widow at Zarephath. Meal and oil. A child raised.
Carmel. The prophets of Baal. Fire on the soaked offering. The drought breaks.
Jezebel’s threat. A broom tree. A still small voice. Elisha at the plough.
Ben-hadad. Ahab’s wars. A prophet wounded. Because you have let go a man I had devoted.
Naboth’s vineyard. Jezebel’s letters. Elijah in the vineyard. Dogs will lick your blood.
Micaiah: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne. A lying spirit. Ahab dies in his chariot.
Jehoshaphat’s ships wrecked. Ahaziah of Israel inquires of Baal-zebub. Elijah’s word.
2kings: Ahaziah and Baal-zebub. Fire from heaven on two captains. Elijah taken; Elisha’s double portion.
The Jordan parted. Bears and boys. Water healed. Moab’s campaign and ditches of water.
A widow’s oil. A Shunammite’s son raised. Stew and death in the pot. Barley loaves.
Naaman’s leprosy. Seven dips in the Jordan. Gehazi’s silver and snow-white skin.
An axe-head floats. Horses and chariots of fire around Elisha. The Arameans struck blind.
Samaria besieged. A donkey’s head for eighty shekels. Four lepers at the gate. The Lord made the army hear chariots.
The Shunammite’s land restored. Hazael smothers Ben-hadad. Elisha weeps over what he will do.
Jehu anointed. The driving is like Jehu — he drives furiously. Joram and Ahaziah shot. Jezebel from the window.
Ahab’s seventy sons. Baal’s house made a latrine. Jehu did not turn from the calves.
Athaliah. Joash hidden six years. Jehoiada’s coup. The priest-king covenant.
Joash repairs the temple. Jehoiada dies. Joash turns. Zechariah stoned. Hazael comes up.
Jehoahaz, Jehoash of Israel. Elisha dying: the arrow of victory. A dead man touches Elisha’s bones and lives.
Amaziah of Judah. A thistle and a cedar. Israel breaks down Jerusalem’s wall.
Azariah (Uzziah) a leper. Zechariah, Shallum, Menahem, Pekahiah, Pekah. Tiglath-pileser.
Jotham, Ahaz. Ahaz’s altar copied from Damascus. The bronze sea disassembled.
Hoshea. Samaria falls. Exile. The calves, the high places, a people who would not hear.
Foreigners in Samaria. Lions. A priest sent to teach the god of the land. Mixed worship.
Hezekiah. The bronze serpent smashed. The Assyrian comes. The Rabshakeh’s speech.
Isaiah’s word. The angel of the Lord. 185,000. Sennacherib at home, killed by his sons.
Hezekiah’s illness, a sign of the shadow. Babylon’s envoys. All that is in your house will be carried.
Manasseh’s long evil. Amon. Josiah begins. The book of the law found in the temple.
Josiah’s covenant, Passover, high places pulled down. He dies at Megiddo. The reform is too late.
Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim. Nebuchadnezzar. Jehoiachin exiled. Zedekiah. The end coming.
Jerusalem under siege. Famine. The city broken. Zedekiah’s sons killed, his eyes put out.
The temple burned, the walls pulled down. Gedaliah murdered. Jehoiachin at Evil-merodach’s table.
1chronicles: Adam to Abraham. The line that matters after exile begins at the beginning.
Judah’s sons. Hezron, Ram, David’s ancestors.
David’s sons in Hebron and Jerusalem.
More of Judah, Simeon, the Reubenites east of the Jordan.
Reuben, Gad, the half-tribe of Manasseh. They transgressed and were taken by Assyria.
Levi: priests, singers, gatekeepers. Aaron’s line.
Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Asher.
Benjamin again, to Saul’s line.
Returned inhabitants of Jerusalem. Gatekeepers. Saul’s genealogy restated.
Saul’s death on Gilboa. He died for his breach of faith.
David king at Hebron, then all Israel. The mighty men. Jerusalem taken.
David’s supporters who came to Hebron. A heart to make him king.
The ark from Kiriath-jearim. Uzzah. Obed-edom. How to carry holy things.
Hiram. More children. Philistines. David’s fame.
The ark brought with levites and song. Asaph. A psalm: Oh give thanks.
A tent for the ark. Ministers, gatekeepers, the daily round of worship.
The house of cedar. A house forever. Who am I, O Lord God?
Wars listed. Moab, Zobah, Edom. The Lord gave victory.
Ammon’s insult. Joab. The crown of Milcom. David’s sons.
The census. Satan stood against Israel. The threshing floor of Ornan. Fire from heaven.
David cannot build. Solomon is named. Materials gathered in abundance.
The levites numbered for service. Gershon, Kohath, Merari.
Priests in twenty-four divisions. Aaron’s sons.
Musicians: Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun. Prophesying with lyres.
Gatekeepers, treasurers, officers of the king.
Military divisions, tribal chiefs. David’s administration.
David’s charge to Solomon and the leaders: the Lord is with you. Be strong and build.
More materials. The plan of the temple given. The Spirit. Be strong and courageous.
David’s last assembly. A prayer: all things come from you. Solomon made king. David dies full of days.
2chronicles: Solomon at Gibeon. Wisdom and knowledge. Horses from Egypt.
A workforce for the temple. Huram-abi, skilled with gold, purple, crimson, linen.
The foundation. The nave. Gold. Cherubim.
The altar, the sea, the stands, the courts.
The ark. Glory so thick the priests cannot stand to minister.
Solomon’s prayer: will God indeed dwell with man on the earth?
Fire. Glory. The feast. The Lord appears: if my people humble themselves and pray.
Building projects, forced labour, the queen of Sheba.
Gold, ships, a throne. Solomon’s wealth. Then he dies.
Rehoboam. A heavier yoke. The split. Shemaiah: this is from me.
Rehoboam fortified. Priests and levites come south. Then he forsakes the law.
Shishak. Humble yourselves and I will grant some deliverance. Rehoboam dies.
Abijah’s speech on the mountain. Judah prevails because they relied on the Lord.
Asa’s reform. The Cushite army. The Lord is with you while you are with him.
Asa’s later years: a treaty with Aram, a seer in the stocks, diseased feet, no seeking of the Lord.
Jehoshaphat. Teaching the law. Ahab’s alliance. Micaiah. Ahab dies; Jehoshaphat returns.
Jehoshaphat’s judges. Fear the Lord. No injustice, no partiality, no bribes.
Moab and Ammon. The battle is not yours but God’s. Singers in front of the army.
Jehoshaphat’s ships wrecked. Jehoram of Judah walks in the way of Ahab. A letter from Elijah.
Ahaziah. Athaliah. Jehu’s purge reaches Judah’s king.
Joash hidden. Jehoiada. The covenant. Athaliah’s death. The people rejoice.
Joash repairs the temple. Jehoiada dies. The princes, the asherim, Zechariah stoned. Aram.
Amaziah. A hired army sent home. Edom. Then gods of Seir, and a thistle’s challenge.
Uzziah strong until he was strong. He burns incense and becomes a leper.
Jotham. Ahaz. The more distressed, the more faithless. Doors of the temple shut.
Hezekiah opens the doors. Priests consecrate. A delayed Passover, and great joy.
Hezekiah’s Passover extended. The levites. The Lord heard Hezekiah and healed the people.
Divisions of priests. Tithes. Hezekiah did what was good and right and faithful.
Sennacherib. Prayer. An angel. Hezekiah’s pride, his illness, his honours. He dies.
Manasseh’s long evil, then chains in Babylon, then repentance and a wall. Amon worse.
Josiah at eight. The book found. The prophetess Huldah. A covenant.
Josiah’s Passover. No Passover like it since Samuel. Then Megiddo, and a lament.
Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim. Nebuchadnezzar. Jehoiachin. Zedekiah. The wrath of the Lord until there was no remedy.
The temple burned. Exile. The land keeps sabbaths. Seventy years.
Jeremiah’s word fulfilled.
Cyrus: the Lord has charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem. Whoever is among you, let him go up.
ezra: Cyrus’s decree. The vessels returned. A first wave listed.
The list of the returned. Those who could not prove their genealogy.
The altar. The foundation laid. Weeping and shouting so mixed you could not tell them apart.
Opposition. A letter. The work stops until the reign of Darius.
Haggai and Zechariah. Tattenai’s question. We are the servants of the God of heaven.
Darius’s search. The decree found. The house finished. Dedication and Passover.
Ezra in Artaxerxes’ seventh year. A scribe skilled in the law. The king’s letter and gifts.
The company that went up. A fast at the river. No escort — we had said God would protect us.
The mixed marriages reported. Ezra’s prayer: I am ashamed. A remnant, a peg in the holy place.
A covenant to put away the marriages. Lists. The book ends in the rain, with names.
nehemiah: News of the broken wall. Nehemiah weeps, fasts, prays the covenant prayer.
The king’s cup. Letters. A night ride. You see the trouble. Come, let us build.
The builders listed, gate by gate, family by family.
Mockery. A half-built wall. Sword and trowel. Our God will fight for us.
The poor and the interest. Nehemiah shakes out his lap. I did not take the governor’s bread.
Sanballat’s letters. A false prophet in the temple. The wall finished in fifty-two days.
Hanani and Hananiah over the city. The genealogies of the first return.
The law read from dawn till noon. The people weep, then are told to eat the fat and rejoice.
Booths, the first time since Joshua. Day by day, from the book of the law.
A long confession: you are the Lord, you chose Abram, we have acted wickedly.
A sealed covenant: no mixed marriage, sabbath, seventh year, temple tax, wood, firstfruits.
Priests and levites in the city. Dedications. Singers. The wall dedicated with two choirs.
Nehemiah’s second visit: Tobiah’s furniture thrown out, sabbath gates shut, mixed marriages pulled by the hair. Remember me, O my God, for good.
esther: Ahasuerus’s feast. Vashti refuses. A decree that every man be master in his own house.
A search for a queen. Mordecai at the gate. Esther taken, and crowned. A plot overheard.
Haman promoted. Mordecai will not bow. A lot cast. A decree to destroy the Jews.
Sackcloth. Fasting. If I perish, I perish. Esther will go to the king.
The golden sceptre. A banquet. Haman’s gallows, fifty cubits, for Mordecai.
The king’s insomnia. The book of chronicles. Haman honours the man he hates.
The second banquet. Esther names Haman. The gallows. They hanged Haman on it.
The signet given to Mordecai. A second decree: the Jews may defend themselves.
The thirteenth of Adar. The enemies fall. Purim instituted. Rest from their enemies.
Mordecai great in the palace. Seeking the welfare of his people. The book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia.
